text: Added an Appearance setting (System, Light, Dark) to the header settings popover, stored per browser in localStorage under `yt.theme`; `theme.ts` writes the resolved value to `<html data-theme>`, and an inline script in `index.html` applies it before first paint. `styles.css` moved the dark tokens from a `prefers-color-scheme` media query to a `data-theme` selector with a system fallback, and the shadcn `dark` variant now keys on `data-theme`. Typecheck and the UI build passed, a Playwright run confirmed Dark persists across reload and System follows OS changes, and it is committed as 03e0624 (not pushed).
